data.title: 14-day demo-first beginner path
data.rule: Do not fund live until the sample and the daily stop are both real habits.

days.title: Open the demo and write the daily stop
days.task: Create a Deriv demo through the partner link. Write account size, 1% risk, and a 2% daily stop on paper.

days.title: Pick one market
days.task: Choose one symbol from the desk. Read the spec. You do not need a second market this week.

days.title: Size before you click
days.task: Run the stake planner. If the number feels small, that is the point.

days.title: Put a clock on the session
days.task: Forty-five minutes. Four trades max. When the clock hits zero, you are done.

days.title: Use the sit-out gate
days.task: Five yes answers or no trade. Sitting out is a valid session.

days.title: Journal three demo trades
days.task: Entry, stop, result, one lesson. If you cannot fill the row, you were guessing.

days.title: Review week one
days.task: Count skips as well as trades. If you broke the daily stop, restart the week on demo.

days.title: Same setup, smaller sample
days.task: Do not change the setup. Take up to four demo trades with yesterday’s rules.

days.title: Drawdown math
days.task: Run the recovery calculator at 10% and 20%. That is why the daily stop exists.

days.title: Losing-streak drill
days.task: See what five losers at 1% leave you. If the leftover looks ugly, shrink risk, not the sample.

days.title: Platform tour, not a live deposit
days.task: Open MT5 or the web terminal on demo. Confirm you can see margin, stake, and close a trade.

days.title: Expectancy, not vibes
days.task: Win rate without average win and loss is vanity. Fill the sample expectancy tool.

days.title: Twenty-trade checkpoint
days.task: If you are under twenty journaled demo trades, stay on demo. Do not rewrite the setup mid-sample.

days.title: Keep the files, decide later
days.task: Download the kit. Live funding is optional and separate. The files still work if you never deposit.
